meta.title: A Value's Life: Owned, Moved, Cloned, Dropped

states.label: Moved
states.sublabel: let t = s; — s is dead

cards.title: Move by default
items: Assignment transfers ownership for non-Copy types
The old binding (s) is permanently invalid after the move

cards.title: Clone is opt-in
items: clone() creates a fully independent copy
Only pay the copy cost when you actually asked for it

cards.title: Deterministic cleanup
items: Whoever owns the value last runs Drop exactly once
No garbage collector pause, no tracing, no finalizer queue
